title: Sample Preparation Protocol for Total Proteomic Analysis of Mouse Tissues
author: Raja S. Nirujogi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bs3tngnn
materials: Dissolve 800 µg, of each of the TMT mass tag reagents within the 11 or 16-plex TMT reagent kit with 41 µL, 100% by vol anhydrous acetonitrile to obtain a 20 µg/µL concentration for each TMT reporter tag.
Pool all samples into a single tube.

steps.title: Tissue Collection and Pulverization
steps.instruction: Snap freeze mouse tissue immediately after isolation in liquid nitrogen and store at -80 °C. Pulverize frozen tissue to a fine powder using a cell crusher kit in liquid nitrogen, ensuring all pulverizer units and spatulas are maintained in liquid nitrogen. Transfer powder immediately to 2 ml tubes and snap freeze.

substeps.instruction: Wash pulverizer with tap water and clean thoroughly several times with 70% (vol) ethanol after use.

steps.title: Tissue Weighing
steps.instruction: Weigh pulverized tissue powder on a weighing balance (target 5-7 mg protein/100 mg tissue). Keep samples on dry ice after weighing.

substeps.instruction: Tare a 1.5 ml tube on the balance.
Use a pre-chilled fine spatula to weigh the sample into the tube.

steps.title: Protein Extraction and Lysis
steps.instruction: Immediately add 2% (mass) SDS lysis buffer at a 10:1 volume-to-weight ratio (e.g., 1000 µL buffer for 100 mg tissue).

substeps.instruction: Agitate samples on an orbital shaker in the cold room at 1000 rpm for 15 minutes.
Boil samples at 95 °C for 10 minutes and allow to cool.
Sonicate samples using a Diagenode Bioruptor at high energy for 10 cycles (30 sec ON / 30 sec OFF).
Clarify lysate by centrifuging at 20,800 x g for 30 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Protein Quantification
steps.instruction: Measure protein concentration using the Bicinchoninic acid assay (BCA) method in triplicate at 1:10 and 1:20 dilutions. Repeat if readings are not consistent. Take 200 µg of protein for total proteomic analysis.

steps.title: Protein Reduction
steps.instruction: Perform reduction by adding a 1:10 dilution of 0.1 M TCEP dissolved in 300 mM TEABC to achieve a final TCEP concentration of 10 mM.

substeps.instruction: Incubate on a Thermomixer for 30 minutes at 60 °C with gentle agitation at 1000 rpm (23 °C).

steps.title: Protein Alkylation
steps.instruction: Bring tubes to room temperature and add a 1:10 dilution of freshly prepared 0.4 M iodoacetamide dissolved in water.

substeps.instruction: Incubate in the dark on a Thermomixer at room temperature (23 °C) for 30 minutes with gentle agitation at 1000 rpm.

steps.title: Alkylation Quenching
steps.instruction: Quench alkylation by adding a 1:10 dilution of 0.1 M TCEP dissolved in 300 mM TEABC to reach a final TCEP concentration of 10 mM.

substeps.instruction: Incubate on a Thermomixer for 20 minutes at room temperature with gentle agitation at 1000 rpm.

steps.title: S-Trap Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the lysate for S-Trap processing by adjusting SDS and acid concentrations.

substeps.instruction: Add 20% (mass) SDS stock to reach a final SDS concentration of 5% (mass).
Add a 1:10 dilution of 12% (vol) phosphoric acid to reach a final concentration of ~1.2% (vol) (e.g., 5 µL into 50 µL).
Dilute the mixture 7-fold using S-Trap wash buffer (90% vol methanol in 0.1 M TEAB pH 7.1 v/v).

steps.title: S-Trap Protein Capture and Wash
steps.instruction: Prepare an S-Trap mini column in a 2 ml tube and load the diluted protein mixture.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge briefly at 1000 x g (23 °C) to capture proteins; increase up to 4,000 g if clogging occurs.
Wash the column 4 times with 400 µL S-Trap buffer, spinning at 1000 x g for 1 minute between washes at room temperature (23 °C).

steps.title: On-Column Trypsin Digestion
steps.instruction: Move the S-Trap column to a clean 2 ml tube for digestion.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL of trypsin solution (13 µg trypsin and 2 µg Lys-C in 100 mM TEAB) (Ratio: 6.5 µg trypsin and 1 µg Lys-C per 100 µg protein).
Centrifuge briefly at 200 x g for 1 minute.
Collect flowthrough and reapply the trypsin solution to the column, avoiding air bubbles.
Cap tubes and incubate at 47 °C without shaking for 1.5 hours.
Incubate for an additional 2 hours at room temperature.

steps.title: Peptide Elution
steps.instruction: Elute peptides from the S-Trap column into a new 1.5 ml 'eluate tube' using three sequential steps.

substeps.instruction: Add 80 µL 50 mM TEAB, spin to elute.
Add 80 µL 0.15% (vol) Formic Acid, spin to elute.
Add 80 µL 50% (vol) Acetonitrile in 0.15% (vol) formic acid, spin to elute.

steps.title: Digestion Efficiency Verification
steps.instruction: Take 1-2 µL of the combined eluate, vacuum dry, and inject into MS (QE HF-X or Orbitrap Lumos) using a 70-minute gradient in FT-FT-HCD mode.

substeps.instruction: Search data with Proteome Discoverer 2.1 or 2.4.
Verify efficiency: Zero missed cleavages >75%, single missed cleavages 20-23%.

steps.title: TMT Labeling Preparation
steps.instruction: Vacuum dry the remaining peptides and store at -80 °C. When ready, dissolve lyophilized peptides in 50 µL of a mixture containing 38 µL 50 mM TEAB buffer and 8 µL 100% (vol) anhydrous acetonitrile (final 30% vol ACN).

substeps.instruction: Place samples on a floater in a water bath sonicator for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge at 20,800 x g for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer dissolved peptides to a 1.5 ml protein low-binding Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: TMT Labeling Reaction
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL of 20 µg/µL TMT reagent (200 µg) to achieve a 1:1 peptide:TMT mass ratio.

substeps.instruction: Gently vortex and spin at 2000 x g for 1 minute.
Incubate on a Thermomixer at room temperature with gentle agitation (800 rpm) for 2 hours.
Add 50 µL 50 mM TEAB buffer to reach a final volume of 100 µL.
Vortex, spin at 2000 x g for 1 minute, and incubate on a Thermomixer for 10 minutes.

steps.title: TMT Labeling Verification
steps.instruction: Take a 5 µL aliquot from each TMT sample, pool them, and vacuum dry using a SpeedVac.

substeps.instruction: Analyze via MS (02:25:00 FT-FT-MS2 study) to ensure >98% labeling efficiency and 1:1 abundance.
Search with Proteome Discoverer 2.2 or 2.4 (TMT reporter tag mass +229.163 Da on Lysine and N-terminus).

steps.title: TMT Quenching and Storage
steps.instruction: Thaw the remaining 95 µL of the reaction from -80 °C to room temperature. Prepare a 5% (vol) hydroxylamine solution from a 50% stock.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 µL 5% (vol) hydroxylamine to each sample and incubate on a Thermomixer at room temperature for 20 minutes.
Take 20% of the reaction (220 µL) as backup, snap freeze on dry ice, and vacuum dry.
Snap freeze the remaining 880 µL and vacuum dry using SpeedVac for high pH fractionation.

steps.title: High pH Fractionation and LC-MS/MS
steps.instruction: Desalt samples using a tC18 50 mg cartridge. Submit desalted samples for high pH fractionation into 96 fractions, then concatenate into 48 fractions (e.g., A1+D1, A2+D2).

substeps.instruction: Measure peptide concentrations of the 48 fractions using a Nanodrop 1000.
Prepare 2 µg of each fraction in 15 µL LC buffer (0.1% vol formic acid in 3% vol acetonitrile).
Analyze each fraction on an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos in FT-FT-FT (MS3) HCD mode (1 hour 25 minute run per fraction).

steps.title: C18 Stage-Tip Cleanup
steps.instruction: Prepare a single layer C18 stage-tip using a 16-gauge needle. Dissolve vacuum dried peptides in 80 µL Solvent-A1 (0.1% vol TFA).

substeps.instruction: Activate resin: Add 80 µL 100% (vol) acetonitrile, centrifuge at 2000 x g for 2 minutes, and discard flowthrough.
Equilibrate resin: Add 80 µL Solvent-A1, centrifuge at 2000 x g for 2 minutes, discard flowthrough; repeat once.
Load acidified peptide digest; centrifuge at 1500 x g for 5 minutes at room temperature. Reapply flowthrough to the column.
Wash: Add 80 µL Solvent-A1, centrifuge at 2000 x g for 2 minutes, discard flowthrough; repeat once.

Elute: Place stage-tips in new 1.5 ml low-binding tubes. Add 30 µL Elution buffer (Solvent-B1: 50% vol acetonitrile in 0.1% vol TFA), centrifuge at 1500 rpm for 2 minutes. Repeat once more with another 30 µL.
Snap freeze eluates on dry ice and vacuum dry using SpeedVac.

steps.title: tC18 Sep-Pak Purification
steps.instruction: Dissolve vacuum dried pooled TMT samples in 500 µL Solvent-A1 (0.1% vol TFA). Sonicate on a water bath floater for 10 minutes, then centrifuge at 20,800 x g for 10 minutes at room temperature and transfer to a new 1.5 ml tube.

substeps.instruction: Verify pH is < 2 using a pH strip (if not, increase TFA to 0.15% vol).
Prepare tC18 50 mg Sep-Pak in a 15 ml falcon tube.
Activate: Add 1 mL 100% (vol) acetonitrile, centrifuge at 60 x g for 1 minute, discard flowthrough; repeat once.
Equilibrate: Add 1 mL Solvent-A1, centrifuge at 60 x g for 1 minute, discard flowthrough; repeat two more times.
Load sample via gravity or rubber bulb; collect and reapply flowthrough.
Wash: Add 1 mL Solvent-A2 (0.1% vol formic acid), centrifuge at 60 x g for 1 minute, discard flowthrough; repeat two more times.
Elute: Move column to a new 1.5 ml tube. Add 300 µL Solvent-B2 (60% vol acetonitrile in 0.1% vol formic acid) via gravity or rubber bulb. Repeat this elution step two more times (total 900 µL).
Combine eluate, snap freeze, and vacuum dry using SpeedVac.
